scenes.heading: How does a Python loop work?
scenes.subtitle: Understanding repetition in programming
scenes.narration: A loop repeats an instruction for each value in a sequence. Let's see how Python makes this simple.

scenes.heading: Step 1: Read the code
scenes.narration: Range of three gives three values: zero, one, and two. The for loop assigns each value to variable i.

scenes.heading: Step 2: Watch each iteration
scenes.narration: Each pass takes the next value, runs print i, and stops when all items in the sequence are exhausted.
